description_en: Invoke this API to query the processing status and result of a batch device registration request.
description_zh: 调用该接口查询批量注册设备申请的处理状态和结果
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-batch-register-device-status --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --apply-id 1295006 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryBatchRegisterDeviceStatus

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the ID of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.


**Important**

*   If your instance has an ID, you must specify the ID for this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
*   If no **Overview** page or ID is generated for your instance, you do not need configure this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
